opinions.text: Appeal from D. C. D. C. Probable jurisdiction noted. Brief of appellant is to *1151be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Thursday, November 13, 1997. Brief of appellees is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Monday, December 15, 1997. A reply brief, if any, is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Monday, January 5, 1998. This Court’s Rule 29.2 does not apply.
